info.name: Areas
info.description:
## Areas

### Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication
Public list/get endpoints require no token. Admin mutators require `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}`.

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on login) |

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin-only mutators for areas (create, update, delete).

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| cityId | number | YES | ID of the parent city. |
| nameEn | string | YES | English name, max 128 chars. |
| nameAr | string | YES | Arabic name, max 128 chars. |

### Notes
`(cityId, nameEn)` and `(cityId, nameAr)` are unique pairs.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |
| 409 | Area name already exists for this city |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| cityId | number | Optional | Reassign to a different city. |
| nameEn | string | Optional | New English name. |
| nameAr | string | Optional | New Arabic name. |

### Notes
Undefined fields are skipped (no change).

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | Area or city not found |
| 409 | Area name already exists for this city |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| areaId | path param | YES | Area ID. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | Area not found |
| 409 | Area is referenced by other rows and cannot be removed |

item.name: Public
item.description: Public read endpoints for browsing areas.

request.description:
### Auth
None — public.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| page | number | Optional | Page number (default 1). |
| limit | number | Optional | Items per page (default 10). |
| search | string | Optional | Free-text match against `nameEn` / `nameAr`. |
| cityId | number | Optional | Filter by parent city. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
None — public.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| areaId | path param | YES | Area ID. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 404 | Area not found |
